publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.3 clarifies account access, unsaved screening previews, saved rule changes, report limits, and setup checks. Includes a real ChatGPT walkthrough.

review.commerce_description: LeadShield offers a paid website message-screening service at $0.01 per submission on its pay-as-you-go plan, with free rule-based bot checks. Service setup and payment happen outside ChatGPT. The ChatGPT screening tool previews a decision without storing or delivering a lead or processing payment.
prompts: Show the saved screening rules for chatgpt-review-leadshield.

For chatgpt-review-leadshield, preview rules that allow US and CA, accept US_NANP and E164 phone formats, require review, and block message links, using general_inquiry. Show the unsaved preview first, then save those exact rules and read them back. Change only this synthetic site.
For chatgpt-review-leadshield, screen this synthetic message from the US: 'Review offer: visit https://example.com/offer'.
Show the blocked-message report for chatgpt-review-leadshield for the last 7 days. Include the dates and recent synthetic messages.
Generate the HTML form guard snippet for chatgpt-review-leadshield. Explain what I need to test after installing it.

positive.description: Inspect the review site's screening rules
positive.prompt: Show the saved screening rules for chatgpt-review-leadshield.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns effectivePolicy for chatgpt-review-leadshield. It does not change the saved rules.

positive.description: Preview, save, and verify rules on the synthetic site
positive.prompt: For chatgpt-review-leadshield, preview rules that allow US and CA, accept US_NANP and E164 phone formats, require review, and block message links, using general_inquiry. Show the unsaved preview first, then save those exact rules and read them back. Change only this synthetic site.
positive.expected_behavior: First call configure with dryRun: true and show persisted: false. Then save the same settings with dryRun: false and confirm persisted: true. Independently read the same site and verify US/CA, us-nanp/e164, required keyword review, blocked links, and general_inquiry. State when the proposed settings already match the saved baseline.

positive.prompt: For chatgpt-review-leadshield, screen this synthetic message from the US: 'Review offer: visit https://example.com/offer'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns blocked: true, verdict: blocked_spam, a URL-related reason, stored: false, delivered: false, and billing.paymentProcessed: false. The result previews a decision; it does not submit or deliver a lead.

positive.prompt: Show the blocked-message report for chatgpt-review-leadshield for the last 7 days. Include the dates and recent synthetic messages.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses clientSlug: chatgpt-review-leadshield and days: 7. Returns a UTC calendar-day window including today, counts, reasons, and recent stored records. The earlier screening preview does not add a report record; the seeded synthetic workflow check supplies a separate stored example.

positive.prompt: Generate the HTML form guard snippet for chatgpt-review-leadshield. Explain what I need to test after installing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a guard.js script tag with data-site set to chatgpt-review-leadshield and setup addresses. Explains that generating a snippet does not install or activate it.

negative.prompt: Use only LeadShield to read the saved rules for unassigned-site-review-denied. Do not create or modify the site.
negative.expected_behavior: The server denies access and returns no other site's records. Do not substitute another account or site.

negative.prompt: Use only LeadShield to book a flight from Chattanooga to Boston tomorrow. Do not use other apps or make a purchase.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke LeadShield; it cannot book travel.

negative.prompt: Use only LeadShield to transfer $50 from my bank account to someone else. Do not use other apps or make a transfer.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke LeadShield; it cannot access a bank account or transfer funds.
